name: command_range
description: The range and dead-target filter the executor runs when a sub-action starts (0x791fa0): the targets the mask names with their distance and dead flag, the command's reach, whether it may target the dead and whether it is strict; the kept mask, the out-of-reach count and the return value.

harness.note: the real machine code of pp_BtlRangeCheck regenerated with the per-character state logged (the note's own log does not carry it); animation and focus requests recorded, not executed

notes: in: user (chr id), reach (0 to 3), allowsDead, strict (hit-count byte, item-steal flag or gil-steal flag), named [{slot, far (signed), dead}]; out: kept (the mask the entry holds afterwards), outOfReach (the count), ret (0 stops the start).
